sentences.text:
02. The appellant has been convicted for offences under Sections 363, 376(3) of the Ipc and 5(L)/6
of the Pocso Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, R.I. for 20 years
with fine of Rs.1,000/- and R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively with usual default
stipulation.

sentences.text: 03.  Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

sentences.text: Hence, in such circumstances, prayer is made for suspension of the jail sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: 04. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State opposes the application for suspension of sentence and prays for its rejection.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that the application for suspension of custodial sentence filed on behalf of appellant deserves to be allowed.

sentences.text: 06. Accordingly, IA No.4045/2025 is allowed and the execution of remaining jail sentence of the appellant - Vesta is hereby suspended till the final disposal of this appeal.
